datasets.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
datasets.notes: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, produced by ESA/Airbus from TanDEM-X; free and open licence (COPERNICUS DEM, (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the EU and ESA).

provenance.processing: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (30 m geographic grid) resampled bilinearly to 40 m per pixel on a local equirectangular grid (dx = 40 m / (111320 cos lat), dy = 40 m / 110540), 256 by 256 pixels = 10.24 km square, north-up, elevation in metres above EGM2008. The Moon twin (moon-slater-plain) is on a polar stereographic grid, not north-up, at the same 40 m per pixel.

stats.method: Central finite differences (numpy.gradient) at 40 m spacing, slope = atan(|grad|) in degrees; histogram has 45 bins of 1 deg from 0 to 45 (steeper pixels counted in the last bin), values are fractions summing to 1. Relief = 95th minus 5th percentile of elevation. Same code for Earth, Moon and Mars.
